summary: Implemented the write-time record-versioning PreToolUse hook (hooks/validate-no-record-versioning.sh), its fixture test, restored the lint/hook scope-agreement case in test-check-record-versioning.sh, bare registration on both settings surfaces plus manifest.json wiring, and a documentation truth-up of the taxonomy's Enforcement section. Redeployed and confirmed live via four real-tool probes: a durable-axis-only write allowed, an unmarked blocking write denied with a rule-naming message, a specs/** write allowed, and self-edits to the hook/test files not blocked. A self-hygiene defect in the hook's own header (a literal 'supersedes v1' example) was caught by the full-repo lint baseline measurement, fixed, and redeployed a second time; the post-fix BLOCKING count matches the documented pre-change baseline exactly (3, all pre-existing and unrelated).
